WRIGHT NEWS INTERNATIONAL 🌍
TOURIST FALLS INTO ACTIVE VOLCANO — FAMILY CLAIMS SHE WAS ABANDONED BY GUIDE

INDONESIA — A 26-year-old Brazilian tourist is trapped inside Mount Rinjani, an active volcano in Indonesia, after reportedly being left behind by her hiking guide.

Juliana Marins fell over 1,600 feet into the volcano on Saturday morning while hiking with a small group. Authorities confirmed that she slipped from a cliffside trail overlooking the crater lake.

Her sister told Brazilian outlet Fantástico that the guide abandoned Juliana after she stopped to rest due to fatigue. “They continued on, and the guide didn’t stay with her,” her sister Marianna said. When he returned later, it was too late — Juliana had vanished over the edge.

Drone surveillance located Marins stuck motionless on a rock cliff approximately 500 meters deep. Rescuers initially reported hearing her screams for help, but poor weather, fog, and dangerous terrain have stalled the mission. Helicopter support has also been grounded due to unsafe flying conditions.

Gunung Rinjani National Park said rescuers were “pulled back to a safe position” for their own safety and that specialized mountaineers are now attempting a renewed effort to reach her.

Juliana’s family has issued an emotional plea for international assistance, accusing Indonesian officials of giving false information and inconsistent updates. “We’re living in a nightmare,” a close friend said in a video statement.

Photos posted by Marins days before the accident show her backpacking, scuba diving, and hiking across Southeast Asia. She had been traveling through Vietnam, Thailand, and the Philippines as part of a long-awaited trip.

The Brazilian embassy in Jakarta is now assisting the family, but questions remain over the accountability of the tour operator and the decision to leave her alone.

Rescue teams are racing against time. As of Tuesday, Juliana’s exact condition remains unknown.

#WRIGHTNEWSINTERNATIONAL
#VolcanoFall #MountRinjani #Indonesia #JulianaMarins #TouristTragedy #TravelSafety

TRAFFIC ADVISORY
PROJECTS COMMISSIONING/FLAG-OFF IN THE FCT
Day 10 - Wednesday, 25" June, 2025

Commissioning of the newly constructed interchange bridges of arterial road N20 (Wole Soyinka Way) over Outer Northern Expressway (Murtala Mohammed Expressway) at the Onex interchange bridge Katampe Extension.

As usual, traffic will be slightly affected at the following points:

A) The service lane-out bound on Murtala Mohammed Expressway also called the Kubwa expressway. Vehicular traffic will be emptied from the service lane into the main carriage way near the Shema Filling Station, approaching the interchange bridges at about 1000hrs.

B) The service lane-inbound the city centre will temporarily be closed to allow ease of exiting of dignitaries after close of event.

C) Traffic connecting Nl6 road towards the new Gishiri bridges might attract high traffic as dignitaries can still exist through the axis.

Traffic control personnel and security agents will be deployed accordingly.

Signed
Head Traffic, DRTS
